expectedIssues: An icon is missing from the top right corner, only a red dot is visible
reportedIssues: The circular control in the header (top right, next to 'DELIVER TO') is an empty light-grey circle with only a red notification dot — the icon or avatar image failed to render, so its purpose is unclear and it has no accessible label.
The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped at the viewport edge and its title reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the name look broken rather than scrollable.
The bottom 'pizza' restaurant card is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation bar; no name, rating or delivery info is visible, so the section end looks like a rendering error.
Favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular background with dark outline, while the pizza card uses a dark/transparent circle with white outline.
The category filter chip row is clipped at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The green promo banner contains large overlapping translucent circles that are cropped oddly at the right and bottom edges, reading as a stray graphic artifact rather than intentional decoration.
Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
